mindnote.heroSubtitle: Your notes, your ideas and your team — in one fluid workspace.
mindnote.mockupBlock3: Your team meets on the same page.
mindnote.statementBody: MindNote weaves your notes into a network. Jump from one idea to the next in a click, and watch your map grow with your knowledge.
mindnote.slogan1Body: Taking a note is just the beginning. In MindNote, every sentence becomes a new node in your knowledge graph.
mindnote.graphTitle: Your ideas are a network. Now it has a map.
mindnote.graphBody: With bidirectional links, notes find each other. The line you wrote yesterday opens the door to today's idea. No forgetting — only rediscovering.
mindnote.perfBody: Notes that open instantly, typing with zero lag, fluid transitions. MindNote never breaks your flow — you think, it keeps up.
mindnote.teamsTitle: From solo brainstorm to the whole team.
mindnote.teamsBody: Keep your personal spaces to yourself; invite your team with a code and think together on the same notes. Everyone on the same page — literally.
mindnote.aiBody: An assistant that summarises long notes, suggests as you write, and answers from your own notes when you ask. It takes the drudgery out of thinking — not the thinking.
mindnote.privacyBody: With row-level security (RLS), every note is accessible only to its owner and their team. Your thoughts, under your control.
mindnote.everywhereBody: Phone, tablet, desktop — MindNote lives wherever a browser does. Pick up from the exact sentence you left.
mindnote.feature1Body: Text, headings, lists — everything is a block. Drag, move, restructure.
mindnote.feature2Body: Build your own knowledge graph with note-to-note links. Your mind map emerges on its own.
mindnote.feature3Body: Organise personal spaces and invite your team with a code. Everyone works from one source.
mindnote.feature4Body: Automatically track workplace-safety legislation from the Official Gazette. Important changes come to you.
mindnote.ctaBody: MindNote runs in your browser. Sign up and create your first note in seconds.

diyetisyen.heroTitle: Your clinic's whole day. One panel.
diyetisyen.heroSubtitle: Clients, nutrition plans, appointments and physiotherapy — all in one place.
diyetisyen.statement1Body: Client files, measurements, plans and sessions — digital, organised and always at hand.
diyetisyen.plansTitle: A plan as unique as each client.
diyetisyen.plansBody: Create, update and share nutrition plans in minutes. Progress measurements are right before your eyes in charts.
diyetisyen.calendarBody: Appointments, follow-ups and sessions in one calendar. No clashes, no forgotten clients.
diyetisyen.physioBody: With exercise programmes, session tracking and progress notes, the physiotherapist module lives in the same panel. As the clinic grows, so does the panel.
diyetisyen.privacyBody: With row-level security (RLS), every client record is visible only to authorised users. Privacy is part of the design.
diyetisyen.ctaBody: Let's tailor the Dietitian Module to your own workflow.

fizyoterapist.heroSubtitle: Exercise programmes, session tracking and progress notes — all in one flow.
fizyoterapist.mockupBlock1: Back programme — 12 exercises, 3 days a week.
fizyoterapist.statement1Body: Programmes are assigned digitally; the patient always knows what to do and when.
fizyoterapist.programTitle: Build a programme in a minute.
fizyoterapist.programBody: Pick the exercises, set the reps, assign to the patient. Updating is just as fast.
fizyoterapist.progressBody: Pain scores, range of motion and session notes tracked with charts. Recovery speaks in data.
fizyoterapist.integrationBody: The physiotherapist module lives in the same system as the dietitian panel. One login, one calendar, the whole clinic.
fizyoterapist.privacyBody: With row-level security (RLS), every patient record is visible only to authorised users.
fizyoterapist.ctaBody: Let's tailor the Physiotherapist Module to your own workflow.

bimola.heroSubtitle: A modern, fast and mobile-friendly showcase site.
bimola.mockupSub: A clear message, clean design, fast pages.
bimola.statement1Title: Speed isn't a feature. It's the standard.
bimola.statement1Body: Pages that open in under a second keep visitors around and make search engines happy.
bimola.speedBody: Thanks to static generation and Vercel's edge network, the site loads at light speed anywhere in the world.
bimola.responsiveBody: From phone to widescreen, the same care at every size: readable typography, balanced spacing, touch-friendly targets.
bimola.designBody: Not a template — colours, type and motion composed around the brand's voice. A storefront that sticks.
bimola.ctaBody: Bimola is online — explore it with your own eyes.
